column6: The warrior, the lordly son of @wDN{Enlil}, @wDN{Ninurta}, the fierce bull, fit to be a prince, the hero manifest in @wTN{E-šu-me-ša}, the glory of @wTN{E-kur}, the rigorous judge, king, …… of the gods, the butting bull, placing his foot on the rebel lands, @wDN{Ninurta}, the lord of @wTN{E-šu-me-ša}, has taken his seat on the throne-dais of @wDN{An}.

Like the new moon he comes forth over the people. Like @wDN{Nanna} he is …… in heaven and earth. He holds in his hand a sceptre of shining precious metal, and the true crown of @wDN{An} is placed on his head. Like @wDN{Utu} he comes forth over the cypresses; like @wDN{Nanna} he stands over the high mountains. @varh[t42701.v1]{The lord in the courtyard } @vart[t42701.v2,t42701.v1]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} The lord, the king }, ……, the king who was born in the women's chambers in the mountains, second in rank …… @gap{at least 6 lines missing}

…… playing ……, …… roaring ……, in the remote …… Lord @wDN{Ninurta} …… all the divine powers …… ornament of @fsux{šuba} stone, @wDN{Inana} ……, beautiful charms ……. The lord of the great place of @wDN{An}, ……. …… in the @fsux{abzu} constantly, the lord, the foremost one of the house of the excellent divine powers ……, greeting @wDN{Enki} in the @fsux{abzu} shrine.

August wisdom filling the Land like the @fsux{abzu}, …… of his pure house, …… he tends carefully, …… he calls. @varh[t42701.v3]{The house of cedar …… } @vart[t42701.v4,t42701.v3]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} The lord …… }. He pours light over the fields. The lord with the holy mouth standing on the high mountains, the light keeping guard over ……, present constantly every month in the great shrine, @wDN{Uta-ulu}, lord of the gods, great hero of @wDN{An's}, great lord of @wDN{Enlil's}, @wDN{Ninurta}, august son of @wTN{E-kur}, lordly son of his own father, your praise is sweet!
